items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 101:1
items.html: (To the question) The whole matter of the attachment of back to back in a single wall with ZA, which operates in the Nukva at the time she is with him, from the chest and below, is because she lacks the aspect of her NHY; therefore there is no coupling in her, in her own aspect, but she receives through the small Nukva in the body of ZA. Hence she is attached to him in his body, like the small Nukva in his body. However, at the time that she receives the Mochin of Binot and Gevurot, from the Ima of the AB of the Mazal, which lower the Hey from her eyes and raise the AHAP, which are new NHY, when she attains the vessel of the Yesod, she is separated from him into the aspect of a particular Partzuf, for now she has her own Achoraim and wall; and also in the aspect of revealed Hassadim, as is known. It is thus found that the giving of the Gevurot not through ZA, namely the Mochin of Binot and Gevurot that she receives from Ima, which build her Achoraim, is what causes her to be sawed apart from ZA, to be a separate Partzuf in itself. And see above in Answer 230. (Item 119).
